comment: C-36 round 4: resolver work counters on a cold index, main (origin/main, 635e90c) against the round-4 head. Counters were inserted the same way in each tree by an experiment-only patch: lookups = calls of find(), lookupComputes = calls of lookupPath() (memo misses), lazyComputes = lazy computations started (main's resolver has no lazy-cache rule, so none are counted there), cuts = cycle cuts and helper or lazy re-entries, replays = lazy and path-call hits, each replaying its stored scope reads and height, setAside = entries the lazy computations set aside and restored (one caller lookup plus the open import expansions and macro imports). One process each, in-thread, run side by side; counts do not depend on load. cpuS are observations on a shared server.

round3.comment: From work-round3.json, same counters on the round-3 head (main was then 60d4f2b; its dioxus counts equal 635e90c's).
